name: bbox-mcp-server
description: The geospatial toolkit for AI agents — query, convert, and verify spatial data with zero config. 6 tools for bounding boxes, coordinate projection, H3 indexing, OpenStreetMap queries, and shareable map verification links.

MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Enables natural language location search (e.g. 'San Francisco'). Optional — if omitted, provide explicit coordinates via bbox.

OVERPASS_API_URL.description: Custom Overpass API endpoint. Defaults to rotating between overpass-api.de and kumi.systems.

MAX_H3_CELLS.description: Safety cap for H3 grid generation. Defaults to 50000.

tools.name: get_bounds
tools.description: Convert and project a bounding box across 6 input formats, 9 output formats, and 3,900+ coordinate systems (EPSG codes). Returns center point, tile indices, area, and a shareable map verification link.

location.description: Natural language location (e.g. 'New York City'). Requires MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.

bbox.description: Geometry to parse: raw lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2 string, WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent.

epsg.description: Target EPSG projection code (e.g. '3857'). Defaults to '4326'.

zoom.description: Zoom level for tile coordinate calculation (0–22). Default: 15.

tools.name: get_h3_indices
tools.description: Generate Uber H3 hexagonal cell indices covering a bounding box at a specified resolution. Optionally returns GeoJSON hex boundary polygons.

bbox.description: Geometry to parse: raw coordinates, WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent.

compact.description: Return compacted cells (mixed resolutions) to minimize response size. Default: false.

return_geometry.description: Include GeoJSON hex boundary polygons. Default: false.

tools.name: generate_share_url
tools.description: Generate a shareable map link to visualize a bounding box on vibhorsingh.com/boundingbox. Useful for verifying results visually.

bbox.description: Geometry to parse: raw coordinates, WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent.

tools.name: search_overpass
tools.description: Execute an Overpass QL query to find POIs, roads, or other OSM features within a bounding box or radius. Returns structured JSON with names, coordinates, tags, and a shareable map link pinning each result.

location.description: Natural language location (e.g. 'JFK Airport'). Requires MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.

bbox.description: Geometry to parse: raw coordinates, WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent.

query.description: Overpass QL core query (e.g. nwr["amenity"="cafe"]). Do not include spatial filters — the server adds them automatically.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in metres for circle mode. Use only when the user specifies an explicit distance.

return_geometry.description: Return full polygon/polyline geometry for ways and relations. Default: false.

tools.name: list_osm_tags
tools.description: Look up the correct OpenStreetMap tags for a given category before writing an Overpass query. Prevents hallucinated or incorrect tag usage.

tools.name: aggregate_overpass_h3
tools.description: Run an Overpass query and bin results into H3 hexagons for spatial density analysis. Returns counts per cell and GeoJSON hex boundaries.

resolution.description: H3 resolution level (0–15) for binning. Default: 8.

data_sources.name: OpenStreetMap
data_sources.description: Global crowd-sourced geographic data. Free and open.

data_sources.name: Overpass API
data_sources.description: Read-only API for OpenStreetMap data. Public, free, rate-limited.

data_sources.name: Mapbox Geocoding API
data_sources.description: Used only when MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN is set. Optional dependency for natural language location search.
